_about: One brief per group, input to eval/prompts/02_questions.md. Each describes a topic at the level a product researcher would know it. Briefs must not contain complaint wording, fixes, features, release names, or dates. Final group list is set when labels are written; add or rename briefs to match.

briefs.brief: The left-hand sidebar: how people find, organize, and get around the pages in their workspace.
Everyday page editing: writing and formatting content, code snippets, and copying or reusing existing pages.
Connecting databases to each other, such as linking projects to tasks, and summarizing linked information.
Working with databases that hold many rows, across the different ways of viewing them.
Using Tessera on phones and tablets: how people rely on the apps day to day and in different situations.
Tessera Calendar: scheduling, events, and how calendar time relates to the rest of people's work.
Tessera Mail: reading, organizing, and keeping up with email inside the workspace.
How much people trust and rely on the answers Tessera AI gives them.
How widely Tessera AI is adopted across a workspace, by people working in different languages, and how admins oversee it.
Sharing pages with teammates and outside guests, and keeping track of who can see what.
Documents that teams produce repeatedly on a regular rhythm.
Finding information in a workspace with search: what people look for and how they narrow results.
The Slack integration: how Tessera activity reaches people in Slack.
Paying for Tessera: choosing and changing plans, seats, payment, and invoices.
Adding new blocks to a page and discovering what kinds of content the editor offers.
How engineering teams use Tessera alongside GitHub to plan and track their work.
Using Tessera with assistive technology and without a mouse.
Developers building integrations on the Tessera API for reading and writing pages.
Developers keeping external systems in sync with changes to Tessera databases.
Keeping database properties filled in and consistent as rows accumulate.
Using the Tessera desktop apps on Mac and Windows: reliability and how they run over a long workday.
How organizations control sign-in to Tessera and meet their security policies.
How Tessera fits into companies whose daily communication runs outside Slack.
